sections.title: Welcome to the Grinder
sections.intent: Establish the protagonist's arrival in a lethal tutorial and their discovery of the broken arena geometry.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist reaches the threshold of the final tutorial boss arena.

sections.title: The Clipping Point
sections.intent: Depict the combat encounter where the protagonist exploits a corner seam to avoid damage and kill the boss.
sections.end_condition: The tutorial boss dies from falling through the world geometry.

sections.title: Looting the Void
sections.intent: Show the protagonist gathering high-level drops from the glitched kill and finding the exit.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist steps through the exit portal into the main world.

sections.title: Statistical Anomalies
sections.intent: The protagonist analyzes their broken rewards and decides to dump all points into Luck.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist confirms the final stat point allocation into Luck.

sections.title: The Long Walk to Town
sections.intent: Demonstrate the immediate effects of high Luck during a dangerous journey to the first settlement.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist arrives at the gates of the starting town, Oakhaven.

sections.title: Blending In (Poorly)
sections.intent: Establish a temporary identity and find a place to lay low while avoiding system-enforced 'corrections'.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist secures a room at a local inn under a false name.

sections.title: Casing the Joint
sections.intent: Identify the Merchant Guild's vault and the physical flaws in its magical security.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist identifies a specific wall segment with a rendering error.

sections.title: The Heist of the Century
sections.intent: Use high crit-rate to 'damage' the physics of the vault door and slip inside.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist successfully bypasses the vault door and enters the treasure room.

sections.title: The Ghost of the Vault
sections.intent: Loot the vault and trigger an alarm that forces a frantic, luck-based escape.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist escapes the city walls as the Merchant Guild declares a bounty.

sections.title: The Hounds are Loose
sections.intent: Show the protagonist being tracked by elite enforcers and fleeing toward a high-level zone.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist enters the boundaries of the 'Screaming Peaks' monster den.

sections.title: Aggro Swap
sections.intent: Use movement exploits to transfer the aggression of high-level mobs onto the pursuing hunters.
sections.end_condition: The hunters are pinned down by a swarm of elite monsters.

sections.title: Predator Becomes Prey
sections.intent: The protagonist realizes they can use the chaos to take out the hunters and the zone boss.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist spots the regional World Boss sleeping nearby.

sections.title: The Perfect Bait
sections.intent: Lure the World Boss toward a specific cliff edge known for fall-damage bugs.
sections.end_condition: The World Boss is positioned exactly at the edge of the Peak of Despair.

sections.title: Newton's Third Law (Broken)
sections.intent: Use a low-level knockback skill to trigger a massive fall-damage calculation error.
sections.end_condition: The World Boss hits the ground, triggering an overflow damage number.

sections.title: The Global Ping
sections.intent: The System reacts to the impossible kill with a world-wide announcement, blowing the protagonist's cover.
sections.end_condition: The global system announcement text fades from the sky.

sections.title: The System's Chosen
sections.intent: The Hero party arrives to 'fix' the glitch, forcing the protagonist into a high-stakes confrontation.
sections.end_condition: The Hero party initiates combat with the protagonist.

sections.title: PvP (Player vs Patch)
sections.intent: The protagonist uses unconventional tactics to survive against the 'legitimate' heroes.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist disables the Hero party's leader with a status-effect loop.

sections.title: Race to the Border
sections.intent: The protagonist flees toward the Unpatched zone as the server maintenance countdown begins.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist reaches the shimmering barrier of the Beta-Test region.

sections.title: Breaking the Fourth Wall
sections.intent: Force a way through the system barrier using every exploit gathered so far.
sections.end_condition: The barrier shatters, allowing entry into the Outlands.

sections.title: The Fog of the Beta
sections.intent: A final chase through a region where the laws of physics are actively fluctuating.
sections.end_condition: The Hero party loses the protagonist's trail in the chaotic terrain.

sections.title: Beyond the Patch
sections.intent: The protagonist finds safety in the lawless zone and prepares for a life outside the System's control.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist looks out over the unmapped territories as the server maintenance completes.
